title: Fights and killings at dance halls; Julia Lee on piano
summary: Smith tells of a knifing death in Sherman and a fight at the Band Box, and says Julia Lee played piano alone.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Did you ever see anybody shot or killed?
No.
Never when you were on a gig? You never saw a fight where anybody got knifed?
Oh yeah, plenty of that. Plenty of that. But I never see nobody... Yeah, plenty of that. I even played dates
Buster Smith - 91
right here in Sherman, Texas, club dates, where over a long foxtail coat a man got killed.
A Black or White fellow?
A colored... A Black fellow.
What was it? Somebody got out a knife and...?

Yeah. They got in an argument... They were all sitting at a table there, and they got in an argument, and they called him... Uncle somebody or other, I forget his last name. But anyway, he was very well thought of. A little chunky fellow. And he drawed out a big knife on the fellow. This other fellow had a buddy with him, and they went out the door. He and the other fellow, the went out the door, and then they waited for this fellow to come out. And when he come out, they ...(?).... And everybody went running and hollering, and we went out there nad looked, and there was this little short fellow and he had the knife in his hand, and he was laying there dead. They shot him right through here.
They shot him.
Yeah.
Wow.

Yeah. And run on off and left him laying there. Sure did. That was right up there in Sherman. That hasn't been too many years ago. But we've seen quite a few people go out and (?) fights and things, and ring around fightin' houses... I
Buster Smith - 92

remember one time when we was playing out here at the old Band Box for the White folks, and they had the law there to keep order in the place. And he was next door talking to the (?) man over at (?), and he come back there and they're dragging people out, everybody... About ten or fifteen of them, dragging them out of there. They had (?)to bring around/a ring around the(?) soldiers to come in and they had a ring around the fight. And he comes walking in and says, "What happened?" I believe he seen what's going on, and he wouldn't come back there until it was all over with. Yeah, they was dragging folks out of there. Four or five of them got hurt there.
What was Julia Lee's band like?
There wasn't nobody playing but her. Just her. All piano.
Just her.
Just her on piano by herself.
